title: firecrawl /firecrawl
summary: 🔥 Firecrawl Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. 🔥 You can use Firecrawl three ways. This repo holds the code for Firecrawl Local and the self-hosted server, along with SDKs that work with all three. Firecrawl Local . Run Firecrawl on your own machine as one binary that turns websites into clean markdown, plugs into your AI agent as an MCP server and serves the Firecrawl API on localhost. Firecrawl Cloud . Use the hosted service at firecrawl.dev for everything Local does at scale with nothing to run, plus search and the 550+ data providers in Firecrawl Alexandria for far more knowledge than scraping alone. Self-hosting . Deploy the full Firecrawl server from apps/api with its own queues, workers and databases on your own infrastructure. Pst. Hey, you, join our stargazers :) Firecrawl Local Firecrawl Local scrapes, crawls and maps from your own machine without a database, queue or container, and it reaches Firecrawl Cloud when your AI agents need search or Alexandria. It installs from crates.io. You need Rust and a C compiler, which on macOS means xcode-select --install and on Debian or Ubuntu means build-essential . cargo install firecrawl-local If you don't have Rust, Firecrawl Cloud runs the same scrape with nothing to build and no signup. npx -y firecrawl-cli@latest scrape https://firecrawl.dev Scrape a page and print its markdown. firecrawl-local scrape https://firecrawl.dev --markdown Crawl a site and save one markdown file per page. firecrawl-local crawl https://docs.firecrawl.dev --limit 50 --out ./pages List every URL on a site. firecrawl-local map https://firecrawl.dev Pages that need JavaScript render in the Chrome or Chromium already on your machine, and PDFs and Office documents are parsed locally too. Without a browser, static pages still work and a page that needed one comes back with a warning. Add it to your AI agent init finds Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI and Codex on your machine and adds Firecrawl Loca
title_es: Firecrawl: infraestructura open-source para potenciar agentes IA
bajada: Firecrawl es una herramienta open-source que convierte sitios web en markdown limpio para alimentar agentes IA, con versiones local, cloud y auto-hospedada. Útil para developers que construyen sistemas que requieren conocimiento web actualizado.
bajada_en: Firecrawl is an open-source tool that converts websites into clean markdown for AI agents, with local, cloud, and self-hosted options. Essential for developers building knowledge-aware AI systems.

title: How Amazon Plays the Long, Expensive Data Center Game That Neoclouds Can’t
summary: INDIANA, Penn.—A visit this week to an Amazon data center project in Pennsylvania coal country gave me a glimpse of the era we all knew was coming: when tech giants lay claim to some of the hardest-to-secure AI infrastructure while smaller cloud providers, which Nvidia has propped up financially, are trying to hang on.The 4.4-gigawatt campus in Pennsylvania, once home to a 2-GW coal-fired power plant near the economically depressed borough of Homer City, could become one of the largest AI power parks in the country.Few companies can marshal the resources as readily as Amazon to transform the site from what it was—a Rust Belt relic that once employed thousands of people but released coal dust and arsenic—into an Appalachian hilltop of gas-fired electrons flowing into 36 buildings powering the AI of Anthropic or others.
title_es: Amazon domina el costoso juego de infraestructura para IA
bajada: Amazon está transformando un antiguo sitio de una planta de carbón en Pennsylvania en uno de los mayores centros de energía para IA del país, con capacidad de 4.4 gigavatios. Este proyecto muestra cómo los gigantes tecnológicos están consolidando ventajas en infraestructura que neoclouds más pequeños no pueden igualar.
bajada_en: Amazon is transforming a former coal plant site in Pennsylvania into one of the largest AI power parks in the country with 4.4-gigawatt capacity. The project shows how tech giants are consolidating infrastructure advantages that smaller cloud providers cannot match.

title: How Apple Got Caught Up in Google Search Ads Slowdown
summary: Google’s shares have fallen 18% since the company reported a sharp slowdown in search advertising revenue growth stemming in part from the increased popularity of its AI features. Google isn’t the only tech company feeling the pain from that shift.Growth in Apple’s services revenue, which includes a cut of ad revenue Google makes when people search on Apple’s Safari web browser, slowed to 10% in the latest quarter from 12% in the prior quarter, and will cool further in the current quarter, executives said on Apple’s earnings call earlier this month. Reddit also warned in its latest quarterly report that Google wasn’t sending as much search referral traffic to its online forums because of AI-driven changes to search features.

bajada: El crecimiento en publicidad de búsqueda de Google se desaceleró tras la popularidad de sus características de IA, afectando ingresos de Apple en Safari y el tráfico de búsqueda a Reddit. Este cambio evidencia cómo las IA generativas están redistribuyendo poder en el ecosistema digital.
bajada_en: Google Search advertising growth slowed due to increased popularity of its AI features, impacting Apple's Safari revenue and Reddit's search traffic. This shift shows how generative AI is redistributing power in the digital ecosystem.
